title: Latent Order Bandits
abstract: arXiv:2605.07304v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Bandit algorithms solve diverse sequential decision-making problems, but are often too sample-inefficient for from-scratch personalization. To substantially reduce exploration times, latent bandit algorithms exploit cross-instance structure implied by discrete latent states, provided that the posterior distribution of rewards and latent states is known and accurate. However, obtaining an accurate model of this structure is difficult, and a small number of latent states may be insufficient to characterize the reward distributions in all problem instances. We propose latent order bandits (LOB), relaxing the assumptions of latent bandits to require only prior knowledge of a \emph{partial order} of action preferences in each state. This allows instances of the same state to vary in reward distributions, as long as the partial order of actions is shared. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07304v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：老虎机算法解决了多种序贯决策问题，但通常对于从零开始的个性化而言样本效率过低。为大幅减少探索时间，潜在老虎机算法利用由离散潜在状态隐含的跨实例结构，前提是奖励和潜在状态的后验分布已知且准确。然而，获得这种结构的准确模型很困难，且少量的潜在状态可能不足以表征所有问题实例中的奖励分布。我们提出潜在序老虎机（LOB），放宽了潜在老虎机的假设，仅需每个状态中动作偏好的“偏序”先验知识。这允许同一状态的实例在奖励分布上有所不同，只要动作的偏序是共享的。例如，流媒体服务上的用户群体可能对哪些电影类型达成一致偏好。
tldr: 本文提出潜在序老虎机（LOB）算法，仅需动作偏好的偏序先验而非精确奖励分布，从而在保持跨实例结构利用的同时，显著放宽了传统潜在老虎机模型的假设限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Latent Order Bandits (LOB), which requires only partial-order priors on action preferences rather than exact reward distributions, thereby significantly relaxing the assumptions of traditional latent bandit models while still leveraging cross-instance structure.
